_help: Test site settings. Seasons: fill in 'dates' (YYYY-MM-DD) once open days are known and the site works out open / opening soon / closed by itself. Tours: set 'active' to true when farm tours restart, and 'bookingOpen' to true with a bookingUrl to show Book buttons. In 'nextSeason', {year} is filled in automatically (this year, or next year once the season has passed). Add ?tours=on to any page address to preview the tours without changing this file. Notice: put a short message (and optional link) to show a yellow bar at the top of every page, e.g. for a weather closure; leave the message empty to hide it.

seasons.name: Sweetcorn & veg
seasons.when: end of July to early September (school summer holidays)

tours.summary: Meet our Aberdeen Angus and Black Limousin cattle, the ponies and the tractors, with one of the family showing you round.
details: Booking is per car (up to 6 people) in hourly slots.
The tour is free. You only pay for what you pick.
